subject: Request: Trial balance increase for scale validation run
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@finlytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel@fastapp.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial load validation — ask for additional trial balance

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — the quick demo was helpful. We're planning a 48-hour scale run to validate our latency p95 and throughput curves for the Q1 integration (see attached POC_Loadplan_v3.pdf). Our initial trial ran out of credits during the iterative burst tests.

As a one-off so we can complete the validation and produce the full test artifacts for your team, could Redwood provision an additional trial balance of 750k token-equivalents (estimated ~3.5M tokens including retries)? Key dates:
- Prep window: Dec 21 (small smoke)
- Full run: Dec 22 00:00 UTC — Dec 24 00:00 UTC

We're operating in the US region and will route traffic through your hosted API with the token provided in the POC workspace. If you need a signed acknowledgement or an internal PO, we can get that to you today.

Attachments: POC_Loadplan_v3.pdf (high-level run plan)

Thanks — appreciate any help here,
— Samir
Samir Khan
Head of ML Ops, Finlytics
samir@finlytics.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Samir Khan <samir@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Trial load validation — ask for additional trial balance

Aditya/Marissa — forwarding Samir's request from Finlytics. They need a one-time top-up to finish a 48-hour throughput/latency validation. I reviewed the run plan (attached) — looks like a controlled burst profile and they'll route through our hosted endpoints.

Can we approve a 750k token-equivalent trial balance top-up for this POC under DL-2026-88? If we need a PO before granting access, Samir indicated they can provide one today.

Notes for approval:
- Customer: Finlytics — mid-market analytics vendor
- Use case: latency p95 validation and throughput curve generation
- Risk: low (non-prod, expected traffic profile documented)

Samir, looped you in for transparency. I can also add Jordan from Sales if we need to tie to contract terms.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

> Aditya/Marissa — forwarding Samir's request from Finlytics. They need a one-time top-up to finish a 48-hour throughput/latency validation.
>
> Can we approve a 750k token-equivalent trial balance top-up for this POC under DL-2026-88?

Thanks Grace — I reviewed the plan and the risk matrix. Approve provisional top-up with the following guardrails:
1) Grant 500k token-equivalents immediately for the smoke + first day.
2) Hold remaining 250k pending receipt of either: a signed short-form PO or confirmation of the Finlytics billing contact (name + email).
3) Set quota window to only allow the run between Dec 22 00:00 UTC and Dec 24 00:00 UTC.

Samir — if you can send the billing contact now (or the short PO), I'll ask infra to apply the first tranche and pre-configure the quota window.

— Aditya
